    Consumer ASIC

    Data Center ASIC Services

    The demand for the next generation of computing and AI is at an all-time high. Companies are looking to build differentiated solutions that precisely fit their design scope. MediaTek is an ideal partner to build extremely high-performance and high-efficiency machine learning solutions that incorporate root of trust security, advanced wired or wireless communications, or industry-specific optimized solutions. 

    Learn more about our extensive design, build, test, and validation program to enable customers looking for a next-generation solution, leveraging our high-quality building blocks (or bring your own IP) and extensive supplier ecosystem.

    Learn more

    Consumer ASIC Services

    Bringing together millions of end users is the goal of any company engaged in consumer product design, and we understand how critical it is to deliver a differentiated, optimized solution.

    MediaTek is an industry leader, capable of combining advanced edge computing with energy efficiency while ensuring cost-effective results. Our extensive experience in consumer ASIC and chipset design helps our customers build better products with their own unique spin. We work closely with our customers to maximize their requirements, including die size, cost, efficiency, and advanced packaging options.

    Learn more

    MediaTek’s ASIC Expertise

    To build world-class custom ASIC, MediaTek starts with a team of veteran chip design experts. Customers can then choose from our extensive catalog of high-performance IP and industry-leading I/O, before leveraging our partnerships with world-leading manufacturing and packaging partners.

    MediaTek can build and supply the chip for your product solution that stands out from all others.

    MediaTek’s premium ASIC design solutions ecosystem

    MediaTek works with partners committed to using renewable energy, and reducing carbon emissions.

    MediaTek covers every vertical in the industry on a wide variety of process nodes worldwide.

    Premium ASIC Solutions: Key Features

    Extensive IP

    High performance, high reliability and energy efficient IP

    Innovative Packaging

    Multi-chip, stacked, interposer, fan-out, or chip-on-wafer design

    Full flow management

    Platform design, reliability, and maximizing operational efficiency and value for money

    Foundry Partnerships at Scale

    We work with all the major foundry players globally

    Energy and Sustainability

    MediaTek optimizes its offering for customers with ESG goals in mind

    Our customer design wins and partnerships encompass hundreds to millions of chips.

    • Automotive TSMC 55nm solution: Arm Core I/O, NPU IP, Video acceleration IP, InFO packaging
    • AISiP, 5nm, 7nm, Core IP, NPU IP, 122G SerDes, Ethernet IP, HBM IP, CoWoS Packaging
    • Telco Security SoC, GF 12nm, Core IP, Interconnect IP, RAS-Enabled IP, Extensive verification
    • High-Temp SoC, 40nm, MRAM/ReRAM, Optimized for die size, Customer IP Blocks, DDR4 IP

      Extreme Compute & Multimedia Platform Unleashing the Full Potential of AI

      Introducing the Genio Pro Platform, MediaTek’s flagship premium IoT AI platform - built on a 3nm process technology node, it delivers extreme-performance compute, GenAI acceleration, advanced vision processing, rich multimedia and flexible connectivity for commercial drones, edge AI devices, machine vision systems, transportation, and logistics platforms. 

      Genio Pro Infographic

      Industrial AI Requires a New Class of IoT Platform

      Industrial systems are no longer simple connected devices. They analyze complex environments, interpret real-time data, and make immediate decisions. From robotics navigating dynamic factory floors to machine vision systems performing high-precision inspection, today’s industrial deployments require integrated AI acceleration, extreme compute, advanced vision processing, and industrial-grade system reliability.  

      Full Genio Portfolio

      Edge GenAI Leadership

      8th Gen MediaTek NPU supports 50+ TOPS of AI acceleration, enabling on-device GenAI and real-time multimodal processing at the edge.

      Balanced Architecture 8-Core

      Powerful Arm v9.2 CPU architecture supports up to 260K DMIPS to deliver high-performance industrial processing and edge workloads.

      Multi-Camera AI Processing

      Supports up to 16 camera inputs with 3x ISP enabling multi-sensor fusion for robotics, drone, and other applications.

      Triple 4K Display with Advanced Graphics

      Supports triple 4K outputs, powered by up to 3.1 TFLOPS of GPU compute, enabling high-resolution graphics and advanced industrial HMI displays.

      8K Video Encode & Decode

      Supports high-resolution 8K video processing for real-time analytics, AI-assisted inspection, and advanced visualization systems.

      Multiple-OS Support

      Supports Yocto, Ubuntu, and Debian environments, enabling streamlined development and long-term deployment across industrial edge applications.
